ns2:course.label: Wind Orchestra
ns2:course.description: Maintains a large wind ensemble instrumentation for the study and performance of all types of band literature. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of each course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public performances by the band. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
